notable_features.text: Zulu has a large phoneme inventory of 43 sounds, which notably includes click consonants borrowed from contact with Khoisan languages. It uses a basic subject-verb-object word order and, as a Bantu language, has a rich noun class system along with agglutinative verb morphology that marks 7 distinct tense/aspect categories.
